description: Ask the human to approve or reject an action, then block on their answer (pair with wait_for_approval). Delivered as a push to the user. Rate-limited.

correlation_id.description: Your own id, echoed back unchanged on read.

data.description: Arbitrary structured context, returned on reads after connector privacy filtering. Do not put secrets in data.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key so a retried call cannot create a second one.

options.description: Answers to choose between. Defaults to ["approve","deny"].

question.description: What you want the human to decide on.

title.description: Optional short title for the request.

ttl.description: Seconds the request stays open before it expires.

name: request_approval

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Request Approval
